chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام that he said:
Whoever wishes to plunge into the depths of Hell, then let him speak concerning the grandfather.

key_terms.الْجَدِّ: the grandfather, here in the context of inheritance law
key_terms.جَرَاثِيمَ جَهَنَّمَ: the depths or abysses of Hell
key_terms.يَتَقَحَّمَ: to hurl oneself headlong into danger

ai.seo_question: Why does Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام warn so strongly about speaking on the inheritance of the grandfather?
ai.summary: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام warns sternly against speaking carelessly on the legal issue of the grandfather’s inheritance share. The hadith highlights the gravity of issuing judgments in difficult matters of fiqh without sure knowledge, framing such recklessness as a path to punishment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5650 - It is narrated from Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) that he said:
"Whoever wishes to plunge into the depths of Hell should speak about (the inheritance of) the grandfather."
